market_question: Will Ethereum dip to $1,500 by December 31, 2026?
reasoning: ETH currently well above $1,500 (likely > $3,000). A drop to $1,500 starting in late 2025 would require a 50%+ decline during a possible bear phase, which is plausible but not a given. I estimate ~37% true odds, below the market's 44%.
evidence_points: ETH/USD usually experiences 70-80% drawdowns in crypto winters but the timing window (Nov 2025–Dec 2026) may not fully capture the next low
If the next cycle peak occurs around late 2025 or early 2026, a rapid drop of that size is possible but not guaranteed; the market is pricing overly bearish risk
Historical Binance one-minute low triggers have happened in past bear markets, but similar setups have not always materialized on schedule
